name: vimplug

scripts.build:chrome: TARGET=chrome vite build && TARGET=chrome node scripts/manifest.ts && node scripts/check-size.ts chrome
scripts.build:safari: TARGET=safari vite build && TARGET=safari node scripts/manifest.ts && node scripts/check-size.ts safari
scripts.package: pnpm build && rm -f dist/vimplug-chrome.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../vimplug-chrome.zip .

description: Keyboard-driven browser control for Safari and Chrome.
